usage.callShape: GET https://war-tracker.com/api/v1/vessels/:imo/position (the registry's POST returns 405 Method Not Allowed — use GET). :imo = a real 7-digit IMO ship number, e.g. 9074729. No request body.

inputExample._note: no JSON body; the only input is the :imo path segment (a real IMO vessel number)

usage.outputShape: On success: body holds the latest AIS position (lat/lon/timestamp) for the vessel. When the ship has no recent AIS fix the API returns HTTP 404 with body.detail = 'no recent position for vessel' (graceful, app-level — endpoint is still working).
quirks: Registry method is WRONG: POST returns 405 'Method Not Allowed'. The endpoint is GET, not POST.
x402 micropayment is charged per call (~$0.001) even when the vessel has no recent position (you still pay for the 404 lookup).
A 404 with body.detail='no recent position for vessel' is NOT a broken endpoint — it means that specific IMO has no current AIS data. Try another active/large vessel IMO to get a real position.
:imo path param must be a real IMO number (7 digits, e.g. 9074729).
usage.guide: Call GET https://war-tracker.com/api/v1/vessels/:imo/position with the x402 wallet (do NOT POST — POST returns 405). Substitute :imo with a real 7-digit IMO number for the ship you want. No request body is needed. On success read the latest AIS position from the JSON body (lat/lon/timestamp). If you get HTTP 404 with body.detail='no recent position for vessel', the endpoint worked but that ship has no recent AIS fix — retry with a different, actively-tracked IMO. Each call costs roughly $0.001 USDC on Base regardless of hit/miss.
